environment.description: FastAPI service deployed behind Kong Gateway (OSS 3.6) with a custom request-validator plugin configured via declarative YAML. The plugin enforces OpenAPI 3.0 schema on POST /api/v2/sessions requiring 'user_id' as string (minLength: 1, maxLength: 64, pattern: ^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$) and 'permissions' field is stripped from inbound requests via a pre-function plugin (kong.service.request.clear_header and body rewrite removing any 'permissions' key before proxying). The schema also rejects requests where Content-Type is not exactly 'application/json'. Additionally, a rate-limit plugin caps /api/v2/sessions to 5 requests per minute per source IP. The X-Session-Token header on admin endpoints is validated by a separate plugin that checks token format against base64 pattern with max length 512 bytes.

functions: local body = kong.request.get_body(); if body then body.permissions = nil; kong.service.request.set_body(body) end

config.network: Private subnet, Kong in public subnet
